title: Home Purchase Financing Fee Schedule — Late Charges, Courtesy Waivers and Returned Payments
content:
**Borrower fee schedule — late charges and returned payments on Home-Only Loan programs**

| Program | Grace period (calendar days after the due date) | Late charge (% of the late installment's principal and interest) | Late charge floor (USD) | Late charge cap (USD) | Courtesy late-charge waivers per trailing 12 months | Returned-payment fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Home-Only Loan 7-Year Fixed | 15 | 5.00 | 10.00 | 25.00 | 1 | 30.00 |
| Home-Only Loan 10-Year Fixed | 15 | 5.00 | 10.00 | 35.00 | 1 | 30.00 |
| Home-Only Loan 15-Year Fixed | 15 | 5.00 | 10.00 | 50.00 | 1 | 30.00 |
| Home-Only Loan 20-Year Fixed | 15 | 5.00 | 10.00 | 50.00 | 1 | 30.00 |
| Home-Only Loan 23-Year Fixed | 15 | 5.00 | 10.00 | 75.00 | 1 | 30.00 |
| Home-Only Loan 25-Year Fixed | 15 | 5.00 | 10.00 | 75.00 | 1 | 30.00 |

**Column notes**

- The *grace period* is a number of calendar days after the installment due date before a late charge may be assessed.
- The *late charge percentage* applies to the principal-and-interest part of the late installment; escrow is not part of that base.
- The *floor* is the least one late charge may be, and the *cap* the most, for the program.
- The *courtesy waiver* figure is the number of late charges that may be waived as a courtesy in any trailing 12 months.
- The *returned-payment fee* is the program figure for a payment returned for a fee-bearing reason.

*Reading the caps (hypothetical installment):* the caps differ by program while the floor and percentage are the same, so the same principal-and-interest amount can meet the cap on one program and not on another — 5.00 percent of 900.00 is 45.00, which is above the 7-Year cap of 25.00 and the 10-Year cap of 35.00 but below the 15-Year cap of 50.00.
